name: part_overall_size
why: REPORT 8CD843, ROUND 21, POINT 2 (28/10/2026). «overall» worked on the views of an assembly only: on the drawings of the parts of 26M000002 the overall length, height and width had to be found among the edges, chosen blind, and came out as 5 mm and 133 mm instead. Now «overall» on a view of a part takes the route of the assembly: the outermost straight edges, the dimension read back and compared with their distance on the sheet.
defect_caught: «overall» on a part ignored in silence (the view gets its contours instead), an overall dimension between edges that are not the outermost, and «overall» with «edges» on a part taken as one of the two.
_why_these_numbers: The plate of «dimensions_arrive_in_the_pdf», 120 x 80 x 10 mm: its front view (V1) shows the length 120 across and the thickness 10 up.

expect.why: the plate whose overall size is dimensioned
a drawing is made on a saved part
the drawing is the active document
the views the dimensions go on
THE ROUTE OF THE OVERALL SIZE, on a part: before round 21 «overall» was not read here

expect.tolerance_why: the overall length, read back from the dimension placed
the overall height of the front view, the thickness

expect.why: the two overall dimensions and nothing else: no contour, hole or chamfer on this call

message_includes: On a view of a part «overall» and «edges» go in two calls
